_about: Which councils the plan brief is served for, and which clauses it skips. Read by app/api/brief/for-property/route.ts via lib/plan-brief.ts (inBriefScope, dropExcluded). Generated 2026-11-09 by a script that reads the section headings in each council's own PDF above every top-ranked clause for a dwelling house in zone R2 (flagged = under a heading for another building type, a named place or estate, or an ancillary structure; garages are not flagged for car parking). A council is listed only if it keeps at least one unflagged clause for every topic, except a topic listed in known_empty_topics (the council has no rows for it, so the brief has no clause to show there), and its recall on the proven rules after the skip meets the recall bar recorded in the claim check OC-29.
limits: Keyword-based: it can miss a wrong-type heading and can flag a right one. Only house projects in zone R2 are covered; every other project type and zone shows no brief. Headings for ku_ring_gai are weakly classified (page footers). A clause-text match (another building type named inside the clause) does not flag a clause whose chapter is for dwelling houses or low density residential. A heading that names houses as well as another type is treated as mixed, not wrong. Garages and carports are not an ancillary structure (they belong in setback and parking sections); outbuildings, basements, pools and sheds are. A clause that names another type but also an ordinary dwelling ('a dwelling, dual occupancy, ...') is not flagged. Known gap: Ku-ring-gai has no landscaping rows in the table, so that topic shows the plain not-found text; any other missing core topic fails OC-29.
